name: PhD in Molecular Engineering
summary: PhD research spanning immunoengineering, materials and sustainability, and quantum engineering. Students enter the program and select research advisors after admission.

timeline.interviews: Interview invitations are emailed after the initial application review; interviews average 15–20 minutes.
timeline.decisions: Molecular Engineering applicants considered by Materials for Sustainability can generally expect notification before mid-January; Immunoengineering applicants by mid-January.

english.note: TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic is required unless the applicant qualifies for the University's primary-language or education waiver. Scores must remain valid within two years of the application deadline. The central minimum-score table is labelled for the remainder of the 2026 admission cycle, so its numerical minimums are not carried into this Fall 2027 listing.

applicationFee.note: PME lists fee-waiver categories including financial hardship, with supporting documentation and a request after application submission. The opened pages do not explicitly confirm international applicants' eligibility.

documents: Academic readiness, research, and interest statement
Transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate institutions attended
requirements.note: GRE general scores are not accepted. Optional GRE subject scores in Physics, Mathematics or Chemistry are accepted only when Quantum is selected as the primary research area; other Molecular Engineering applications do not accept GRE scores. Three recommendation letters are recommended. Applicants list at least two PME faculty of research interest; contacting faculty is not required.

funding.note: PME describes a standard full funding package for PhD students for the duration of study while in good academic standing: tuition, living stipend, individual health-insurance premium, quarterly student-services fee, and a one-time discretionary support stipend. The opened PME page does not explicitly address international eligibility.

international.note: University guidance states that international applicants have the same application requirements and must meet the English-proficiency policy or qualify for a waiver.
